subject: Stepdown rollout playbook — GreenGridRx go-live & canary plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelsey Rivera <kelsey@greengridrx.com>, Elliot Nash <elliot.nash@greengridrx.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stepdown rollout playbook — GreenGridRx go-live & canary plan

Kelsey, Elliot —

Congrats again on signing. Attached is our first draft of the Mutual Action Playbook (GG_MAP_v1.0.xlsx) with the post-signature implementation plan embedded — it covers rollout windows, canary gates, migration sequence, and training cohorts. High-level asks:

- Please confirm the primary POC for day-of cutover and training attendees (we've left slots for 3 engineers + 2 ops SMEs).
- Approve the canary gating metrics on page 3 (50ms median generation, <1.0% token error rate, and <0.3% forced fallbacks over a 2k request window).
- Flag any compliance blackout dates or maintenance windows through July.

Key bullets from the playbook:
- Canary phase (Day 0–3): 5% traffic; real-time dashboard; rollback threshold = sustained error rate >0.8% for 15m or p95 latency >300ms for 10m.
- Progressive rollout (Day 4–14): 5→25→60→100% with automated health gates and manual approval at each jump.
- Migration cutover: DNS switch + config flip at 02:00 local, 2-hour observation window, feature-flagged fallback route to standby model.
- Training: two 90-min sessions (train-the-trainer + ops runbook rehearsal) scheduled in Week 1 pre-cutover.

I've attached the canary checklist PDF and the migration-playbook.md as stubs. If this looks good, we'll lock dates and build the RMAs in HubSpot (deal GG-4782).

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: GG_MAP_v1.0.xlsx] [Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf] [Attachment: migration-playbook.md]

> 
> Congrats again on signing. Attached is our first draft of the Mutual Action Playbook...

Thanks Markus — this is helpful and aligns with our internal expectations. Quick notes from our side:

- POC: Elliot will be the technical day-of lead and I will manage stakeholder comms.
- Training attendees: Verified — Engineering: Miguel Torres, Priya Shah, and Ana Lopez. Ops SMEs: Sara Kim, Julian Park. We can share their calendar availability in a follow-up.
- Compliance: we have a vendor blackout 7/4–7/5 (federal holiday) — no scheduled changes those days.

A couple of asks:
1) Can you include a short-runbook excerpt that lists the exact API switch steps (we need comms-ready bullets)?
2) Our security team asked if you can provide a monitoring playback that shows how the rollback triggers behaved in your last two customer canaries (an anonymized graph or table is fine).

If you can get those items before EOD Monday (7/2), we can lock the training slots for the week of 7/9.

—Kelsey
VP Product & Ops
GreenGridRx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kelsey Rivera <kelsey@greengridrx.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stepdown rollout playbook — GreenGridRx go-live & canary plan

Kelsey, Elliot —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attendee confirmation. I've updated the playbook with a concise API switch runbook (see migration-playbook.md) and attached the canary checklist PDF with the gating time windows and metric thresholds called out explicitly. Highlights:

- API switch runbook (summary): 1) Pause non-critical background jobs; 2) Deploy config change to routing layer; 3) Flip feature flag to green model; 4) Increment traffic per canary plan; 5) Monitor; 6) If any gate trips, flip flag back + redirect to standby.
- Rollback triggers (operationalized): sustained p95 latency >300ms for 10m OR token error rate >0.8% over a sliding 2k request window.
- Observability: we will provision a temporary dashboard (read-only link below) with p50/p95/p99 latencies, token error rate, token fallback rate, and model load on GPUs.

Action owners (suggested):
- Cutover lead: Elliot Nash (GreenGridRx) / Redwood on-call (Priyom) as backup.
- Monitoring & rollback: Laura Bennett (Redwood).
- Training delivery: Redwood CSM + GreenGrid product trainer.

I attached the canary checklist. We will also produce an anonymized playback of prior canary behavior and upload it to the Drive link.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf]

From: Elliot Nash <elliot.nash@greengridrx.com>

Cc: Kelsey Rivera <kelsey@greengridrx.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stepdown rollout playbook — GreenGridRx go-live & canary plan

Thanks Priyom — that clarifies a lot. A few follow-ups before we lock dates:

- Rollback specifics: for the rollback action, can you confirm if the feature-flag flip is atomic across regions (i.e., a single API call) or will it roll per-region? We prefer a single atomic flip to avoid split-brain during the 2-hour observation window.
- Monitoring playback: we'll need the anonymized chart & a short notes doc describing the last two canaries (what tripped, how long to remediate). Is that something you can share to the Drive link by EOD Thursday (7/5)?
- SOC/compliance: our security lead may request a short call to review the temporary logs retention policy during the canary. Who should we loop in on Redwood's side?

If you can confirm atomicity of the feature-flag flip and share the canary playback by Thursday, we'll confirm the 7/9 training window.

—Elliot
Senior Engineering Manager
GreenGridRx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Nash <elliot.nash@greengridrx.com>, Kelsey Rivera <kelsey@greengridrx.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stepdown rollout playbook — GreenGridRx go-live & canary plan

Elliot —

Quick answers and next steps from Redwood security & ops perspective:

- Feature flag flip: atomic across our primary region (we support a single control plane flip that propagates sub-second to edge routers). For cross-region customers we provide a scoped per-region toggle; for GreenGridRx (single-region) we'll use the atomic flip.
- Canary playback: anonymized charts uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/greengridrx/canary-playbacks/ (read-only). Included notes: two prior canaries — one tripped on increased token fallback due to model cold-start (remedied with a warmup prefetch) and one saw p95 latency spike during a burst; both remediated within 12–18 minutes and the rollback thresholds were never crossed.
- SOC ask: loop in Samir Patel (redwood.security@redwoodinference.com) for the temporary logs retention review — he'll join a 30-min sync if your security lead proposes a time.

Finalizing training: we have two slots open 7/10 14:00–15:30 PT and 7/11 09:00–10:30 PT. Please confirm which works for your teams and we'll send calendar invites with runbook rehearsals attached.

Summary action items:
1) GreenGridRx to confirm training slot and attendees (Kelsey).
2) Redwood to upload canary playback + short notes (Priyom/Laura) — target 7/5 EOD (completed, link above).
3) Security sync (Samir) if requested by GreenGridRx security.
4) Lock cutover window excluding 7/4–7/5 federal holiday.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: migration-playbook.md]
